sqlMap.select: SELECT TH.DOCDAT, TH.TASKKY, TI.STKNUM, TI.SVBELN, SUM(TI.QTTAOR) QTTAOR, COUNT(*) CNT, MAX(SI.PTNRKY) AS PTNRKY, SH.DRIVER FROM HANTA.TASDH TH, HANTA.TASDI TI, HANTA.SHPDH SH, HANTA.SHPDI SI WHERE 1=1 $RANGE_SQL$ AND SH.DRIVER = #DRIVER# AND TH.TASKKY = #TASKKY# AND TI.STKNUM = #STKNUM# AND TI.SVBELN = #SVBELN# AND TH.TASKKY = TI.TASKKY AND TI.SHPOKY = SH.SHPOKY AND SH.SHPOKY = SI.SHPOKY GROUP BY TH.DOCDAT, TH.TASKKY, TI.SHPOKY, TI.SVBELN, TI.STKNUM, SH.DPTNKY, SH.DRIVER ORDER BY TH.DOCDAT DESC
